images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: DEFEAT BLOOD OVERLAY for The Seven Simulation RPG, grim dark fantasy party RPG about the Seven Deadly Sins and Satan's armies, Diablo 2 mood.
Generate ONE landscape PNG, EXACTLY 1536x1024, genuine transparent alpha background. This is a sparse TOP EDGE accent overlay, not a full illustration. All visible pixels must be confined to the TOP 30% (y=0 through y=306); the entire lower 70% MUST be completely transparent and empty. Top band touches canvas top edge, full-width designs touch left and right edges. Keep shapes chunky when scaled to a 1202x452 battle arena; unit cards must remain readable.
Reference image 1 in the user message is STYLE ONLY: existing dark fantasy cartoon skill effect sheet. Match specifically the red blood shapes in its top-middle, top-right and middle-right cells: thick uneven near-black contours around every shape, broad angular cel-shaded shapes with sharp tapered points, serious menacing mood. Do not copy its sheet layout or subjects. Reference image 2 is placement, scale and dark-screen context ONLY; do not render any of it.
FLAT FILLS ONLY: each blood shape has one flat deep crimson body around #a8141c, ONE flat darker maroon shadow plane around #4a070c, and ONE small crisp pale-red highlight stroke around #e86060. Only these decisive angular color planes, with thick near-black contour. Few large readable angular slightly faceted droplets and drips; never hair-thin lines.
NOT REALISTIC, NOT GORE: no photographic blood, glossy wet 3D, soft gradients, airbrush, glow, bloom, haze, mist, vignette fill, red fog, light rays, painterly texture, watercolor, noise, speckle dust, tiny spatter grain, pink, magenta, orange or purple. No organs, wounds, bodies, weapons, cards, UI, characters, scenery, background, text, frames, checkerboard pattern or solid backdrop. Empty space is actual alpha transparency.

Image 1: TOP DRIP BAND. A jagged blood band hugging the TOP edge across the FULL WIDTH, uneven thickness about 2–5% of canvas height (20–51 px). Exactly 9 hanging drips of clearly unequal length: seven short drips 5–12% of canvas height, two longer drips up to 25% (256 px). The two longest end in heavy angular teardrops. Angular cartoon drips and thick contour; all art ends before y=307.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: previous attempts made drips too long. On this 1536x1024 canvas, constrain the whole illustration to an extremely SHALLOW strip at the VERY TOP, maximum y=255 pixels INCLUDING outline, droplets and antialiasing. NOT 400 pixels. Keep band itself about 20 pixels high. Bottom 768 rows are PURE EMPTY ALPHA=0, no stray pixels anywhere. Absolutely NO cast shadows, ambient red glow, gradient red haze or translucent surrounding shading. Hard-edged sticker shapes only, flat fills, near-black contour. Do not fill the canvas with a black background. Preserve the requested number and arrangement of drips, shorten all drips as necessary to remain inside y=255. Output dimensions 1536x1024.
